items.title: Matas Buzelis hasn't been shy about how great he wants to be.
items.author: Drew
items.body_excerpt:
Matas Buzelis hasn't been shy about how great he wants to be.

But have we confused his ambitions with evidence of his trajectory?

After two seasons, I see a very good complementary player more than a franchise centerpiece.

He's 21. There's plenty of time to show us otherwise.

items.title: The scouting report on Matas Buzelis was to be physical.
items.author: Drew
items.body_excerpt:
The scouting report on Matas Buzelis was to be physical.

He apparently took note.

On Cousins, Buzelis told Vince Carter and Tracy McGrady he added about 12 pounds this offseason after hiring a chef.

“I've been driving and hitting dudes, bumping, stuff like that. Just everything more physical…”
